notes: New: a goal body fat percentage, sitting right next to your goal weight in Profile
Your Vitality score now tracks progress toward that goal exactly the way it tracks your weight goal, and the breakdown says which it is using
New: a body fat percentage over time chart and a progress line on your bodyweight log, showing how far you have come and what is left
If a body fat goal is set below the essential-fat floor (about 5 percent for men, 13 percent for women) the app says plainly that it is not a level anyone can hold
